'''Dai'Dore '''are described in the [[Wheel of Time]] RPG extension, ''Under the Dragon's Banner''. They are not canon material.

The Dai'Dore is a master of battle, its name literally meaning Dai=Battle, Dore=Dancer. 

Many Dai'Dore consider themselves adventurers, no matter what purpose they pursue.
